tips.text: Start the Detonite Injector research first, then farm Uranus for Ampules, Gallium and Plastids while the timers run.
Rank the Kohmak you keep to 30 before Twin Kohmak consumes it; only one copy needs ranking for the Mastery.
Farm these resources while levelling other gear instead of in a separate session.
Nobody complains about the Kohmak farm; the real cost is the Forma and Plastids Twin Kohmak adds.
